driver.bar.heading: To {place}
driver.bar.bagsFree: {count, plural, one {# bag} other {# bags}} free
driver.run.title: Your scheduled runs
driver.run.teach: Tap when you arrive and again when you are loaded. The times are taken here, so nobody has to remember them later.
driver.run.terms: This fleet allows {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} at each stop. After that it charges {rate} {currency} an hour to whoever kept you.
driver.run.noTerms: This fleet does not charge for waiting.
driver.run.empty: Nothing booked on this run yet.
driver.run.secureLede: Tick what you have done with {what}, and photograph it as strapped down.
driver.run.securePhotoPh: Take one and paste its id
driver.run.securePhotoHint: This is the photograph that settles an argument about damage at the other end. It protects you first.
driver.run.podPhoto: Photo of the goods as delivered
driver.run.podPhotoPh: Take one and paste its id
driver.run.handOverLede: You are recording that {what} came off the truck and somebody took it. This is what the sender is told.
driver.run.whoTookHint: If nobody gave a name, leave it blank — the delivery still counts.
driver.run.nothingOwed: Inside the free time — nothing owed.
driver.run.owedByShipper: {minutes} min over. {amount} {currency} owed by the sender, who kept you.
driver.run.owedByConsignee: {minutes} min over. {amount} {currency} owed by the receiver, who kept you.
driver.run.waived: Your fleet let this one go.
driver.offline: No signal — showing what we last knew.
driver.update.aria: A new version is ready — update now
driver.update.title: Update the app
driver.gate.title: This app needs updating
driver.gate.body: A newer version is required before you can carry on working.
driver.gate.item1: Nothing you have claimed is lost
driver.signin.title: Who is driving?
driver.signin.lede: Sign in with the phone number you are registered with, and your 5-digit PIN. No PIN yet? Choose “Forgot your PIN?” to set one.
driver.signin.phoneNote: The number you signed up with — or, if a fleet took you on, the one they registered for you.
driver.signin.notDriver: This phone is not registered to a driver
driver.signin.notDriverNote: Your PIN is fine — no driver is registered to this number. Check the number you signed up with, or the one your fleet used if they took you on. Not signed up as a driver yet? Use “New here? Sign up” below.
driver.signin.codeLede: We send a code to your phone. Type it here, then choose a 5-digit PIN.
driver.signin.why1: Nobody can drive as you with your badge alone
driver.signin.why2: A new PIN signs out every other phone
driver.signin.why3: Five wrong PINs lock it; a code opens it again
driver.signin.aloud: Type the phone number you are registered with, then your five digit PIN. No PIN yet? Tap “Forgot your PIN?”, and we send you a code to choose one.
driver.route.title: Where are you going?
driver.route.lede: We only offer loads that are on your way and fit the space you have left.
driver.route.emptyTitle: We could not load the places list
driver.route.emptyDetail: Check your signal, then try again.
driver.route.modeAria: How you are looking for work
driver.route.ledeNear: Loads around you right now. No route to name — just how far you will go.
driver.route.radiusNote: We will only send you loads inside this distance — and it moves with you.
driver.route.aloudNear: Looking for loads within {km, plural, one {# kilometre} other {# kilometres}} of where you are now.
driver.route.customMapLabel: Where the road ends — tap the map to place it
driver.route.locOff: Turn on location so your route starts where you are — or choose a place below.
driver.trips.title: My trips
driver.trips.lede: Saved like an alarm: before each one we tell you how many loads are on your way.
driver.trips.none: No trips saved yet. Under “Find work”, choose where you are going, then “Save this trip”.
driver.trips.noneFleet: Your fleet has set no trips for you.
driver.trips.sheetBody: {from} → {to}. Choose the days and the time you leave: before each one we tell you the loads on your way.
driver.trips.back: And back at (leave empty if not)
driver.trips.backHint: On the same days, from {to} to {from}.
driver.trips.name: A name for it (if you like)
driver.trips.pendingBody: Start your shift to see the loads on your way.
driver.toast.tripSavedDetail: Before each one we tell you how many loads are on your way.
driver.route.pinned: Pinned. We will look for loads along this road.
driver.route.noPin: Type the name and tap “Find it on the map”, or tap the map to place it yourself.
driver.route.geoApprox: Found {where}, roughly. Move the pin if it is not right.
driver.route.geoGuess: That name is not on our map — this is a best guess. Tap the map to place it yourself.
driver.route.geoNotFound: Could not find that place — tap the map to place it yourself.
driver.route.aloud: Choose where you are starting from and where you are heading. We will only offer you loads that are on your way and fit in your {vehicle}.
driver.push.title: Be told when work comes up
driver.push.reason: A load near you goes to whoever takes it first. We will tell you the moment one appears, and before your licence runs out — on this phone, with the app closed.
driver.home.startLede: Scan the QR sticker on the {place} of the vehicle you are riding today.
driver.home.upkeep: Upkeep of {plate}: readings, services, off the road
driver.home.stickerBody: Print this and put it on the dashboard, where it can be scanned from the driver’s seat. Anyone who scans it and is cleared for this vehicle can start a shift on it — so it belongs inside the cab, where a passer-by cannot reach it.
driver.home.stickerBodyRidden: Print this and fix it to the frame, somewhere you can reach it and the rain cannot. Anyone who scans it and is cleared for this vehicle can start a shift on it, so keep it out of sight when you are parked up.
driver.home.stickerPrintNote: Stick this inside the cab, where it can be scanned from the driver seat. Scanning it starts a shift on this vehicle for anyone cleared to drive it.
driver.home.stickerPrintNoteRidden: Fix this to the frame, out of the rain and out of sight when you are parked. Scanning it starts a shift on this vehicle for anyone cleared to ride it.
driver.home.stickerPrintBlocked: Your browser blocked the print window. Allow pop-ups for this site, or take a screenshot of the code above.
driver.clearance.needTitle: Two documents before your first load
driver.clearance.needBody: A motorcycle or anything larger needs your ID and your driving licence checked. Send photos of both and staff will look at them.
driver.clearance.sheetBody: Photograph both, flat and in good light. Staff read them by hand — nothing is checked automatically, and nothing on your account changes until they have. The photos are deleted once they have decided.
driver.clearance.pendingBody: Staff are checking your ID and licence. You will be told the moment you are cleared to take a load.
driver.home.qrNote: Scanning the sticker couples you to that vehicle for the day.
driver.home.allBusy: All of your vehicles are out with someone else. Scan the one you are taking instead.
driver.home.offRoadDetail: Renew it, then send a photo of the new card here, or show the card at the fleet office. They record the new date, and shifts start again from then.
driver.home.licenceDueTitle: Your licence runs out in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
driver.home.licenceDueDetail: Renew it in time, then send a photo of the new card here or show the card at the fleet office, or shifts stop on that day.
driver.home.offRoadDetailOwn: Renew it, then send a photo of the new card here. The network checks it and records the date; shifts start again from then.
driver.home.licenceDueDetailOwn: Renew it in time and send a photo of the new card here, or shifts stop on that day.
driver.licence.sheetBody: A clear photo of the new card, with the expiry date readable. Network staff read the same photo and record the date. Until they do, nothing changes.
driver.licence.expires: Expiry date on the new card
driver.licence.sent: Sent. The network will check it.
driver.licence.sheetBodyFleet: A clear photo of the new card, with the expiry date readable. Your fleet office reads the same photo and records the date. Until they do, nothing changes.
driver.licence.sentFleet: Sent. Your fleet office will check it.
driver.licence.pendingDetailFleet: Waiting for your fleet office to check it. You read the expiry as {expires}.
driver.licence.pendingDetail: Waiting for the network to check it. You read the expiry as {expires}.
driver.licence.refusedTitle: Your licence photo was not accepted
driver.home.hoursNearLine: On duty {onDuty} h of {limit} h — less than an hour left
driver.home.hoursOverLine: On duty {onDuty} h — over the {limit} h limit
driver.home.restTitle: Resting: you can start again from {time}
driver.home.restDetail: After a working day the next shift waits for {rest, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} of rest.
driver.home.restAsked: After a working day the next shift waits for {rest, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} of rest. We will tell you when you can start.
driver.home.restTellMe: Tell me when I can start
driver.home.hoursOverDetail: You have been on duty more than {limit} h. Deliver what is aboard, then end the shift and rest {rest} h — no new load is offered or taken until then.
driver.home.allOffRoad: None of your usual vehicles can be taken today: off the road until the office records the renewed paper, or out with someone else. Scan another one if you are taking it.
driver.home.whereTodayNote: Pick the road you are running and we will only send you loads on it. You can also say later.
driver.home.headingNote: We only send you loads on this road. Turned round? Say so.
driver.home.headingUnsetNote: Until you do, we send you anything nearby — including loads going the other way.
driver.home.minEarnUnset: You are woken for any job near you.
driver.home.positionsToFleet: {fleet}’s own system is told where you are while you are on this shift, at most every {n, plural, one {minute} other {# minutes}}. Your fleet decided this.
driver.home.standstillWatch: If your vehicle stands in one place more than {n, plural, one {a minute} other {# minutes}} where it has no reason to — away from your stops, your fleet’s sites and the network’s hubs and shops — your fleet’s office is told and may call you. Your fleet decided this.
driver.home.silentWatch: If this phone says nothing for more than {n, plural, one {a minute} other {# minutes}} while you are on a shift, your fleet’s office is told where it was last heard and may call you. It says nothing while this app is closed, or the phone is off or out of signal. Your fleet decided this.
driver.home.minEarnSet: You are only woken for jobs paying {amount} or more.
driver.home.rateHighTitle: {count, plural, one {# job} other {# jobs}} near you were more than the sender would pay
driver.home.rateHighDetail: Your price is {rate} per km. Lowering it would put more of the work near you within reach.
driver.home.rateHighDetailNoRate: Lowering your price per km would put more of the work near you within reach.
driver.home.minEarnSheetTitle: Least I will be woken for
driver.home.minEarnSheetBody: We will still show you everything when you go looking. This only stops the phone waking you for small jobs.
driver.home.snoozeSheetBody: We will stop sending you new work. Anything you are already carrying stays yours to deliver.
driver.home.snoozeSheetNote: This does not count against you, and it ends when your shift does.
driver.home.snoozedNote: Loads you already have are still yours — hand them over and deliver as normal.
driver.home.scan1: This {vehicle} becomes yours for the day
driver.home.scan2: You can pick up loads on your route
driver.home.scan3: End the shift to hand the {vehicle} back
driver.home.darkBody: No signal from {from} to {to}. Any load offered in that time went to another driver. Anything you recorded is being sent.
driver.load.title: What your {vehicle} takes
driver.load.body: Loads are offered to you by these figures. Lower them if your {vehicle} takes less than is assumed.
driver.load.kg: The most it carries, in kg
driver.load.litresHint: Length × width × height of the load space in cm, divided by 1,000. Leave it empty if you do not know.
driver.load.errKg: Say the most it carries: a whole number of kg above nothing.
driver.load.errLitres: The load space is a number of litres above nothing, or left empty.
driver.load.length: Length of the load space, in metres
driver.load.lengthHint: A long item is offered to you only where it fits. Leave it empty if you do not know.
driver.load.errLength: The length is between 0.5 and 20 metres, or left empty.
driver.helpers.title: Who works with you
driver.helpers.lede: A load that needs more hands at an end is offered to you only if you bring them.
driver.helpers.saved: Saved: loads are offered to you by who works with you
driver.toast.loadSavedDetail: {kg} kg · {litres} litres. Loads are offered to you by these.
driver.toast.loadSavedKg: {kg} kg. Loads are offered to you by this.
driver.home.showBadgeSub: For the shop or hub to scan at pick-up
driver.home.badgeBody: Hold this up at the counter. The shop or hub scans it to hand you their parcels.
driver.home.badgeQrLabel: Driver badge {id} as a scannable code
driver.home.badgeShift: The code at the end is new each shift: your badge number on its own hands over nothing
driver.home.badge2: They can also type the code under it
driver.home.endBody: {plate} goes back to the fleet. You will not be offered any more work today.
driver.home.end1: Anything already on board stays your job
driver.home.end2: You can start a new shift any time
driver.home.end2Rest: After a working day you rest: your next shift can start {rest, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} from now
driver.home.rateBody: Your price changes to {price} per kilometre — what most drivers charge.
driver.home.rate1: Shippers compare prices before offering work
driver.home.rate2: You can change it back any time
driver.loads.noBadgeDetail: You cannot scan bags on board until the office adds your badge number.
driver.loads.findHint: Scan a package’s barcode or the QR on its label, or type the load’s code: you see which of your loads it belongs to, and open its pickup from there. A package that is not yours reads as no load.
driver.loads.empty2: Claim the loads on your way
driver.loads.pick1: Every parcel inside moves to your {vehicle}
driver.loads.pick2: The shop is told it has left
driver.loads.pick3: Your delivery is booked against your badge
driver.loads.tempBeforePickup: Kept between {min} and {max} °C — cool the body to it before you collect.
driver.loads.logTempBody: Keep this load between {min}°C and {max}°C. Enter the current reading.
driver.loads.gateBodyPickup: {ref} — {kg} kg to {dest}. Confirm each item before you pick this up.
driver.loads.gateBodyDeliver: {ref} — {kg} kg to {dest}. Confirm each item before you mark it delivered.
driver.loads.securePhotoAria: Take a photo of the secured load
driver.loads.addPhoto: Add a photo of the secured load.
driver.loads.reservationsLabel: Anything wrong with the goods as handed over? (optional)
driver.loads.reservationsHint: A torn sack, a short count, a wet pallet — it goes on the consignment note as your reservation, before the goods are yours to answer for.
driver.air.truckFlightTitle: A trucked flight — carried as a road load
driver.air.countHint: Count what {handler} hands you before you leave the shed: air waybill {awb} says {pieces}.
driver.air.countDiffersDetail: It goes on the consignment note as your reservation, so the road does not answer for what the shed never handed over. The importer is told to complain to the airline.
driver.air.receiptHint: Ask {handler} for its receipt for air waybill {awb}: its acceptance or warehouse receipt number. It shows the goods were in before the latest acceptance time.
driver.air.receiptFirst: Give the handler’s receipt number first.
driver.loads.receiverPlaceholder: Name of the person at the gate
driver.loads.podPhotoLabel: Photo of the goods as delivered
driver.loads.podPhotoAria: Take a photo of the goods where you put them down
driver.loads.positionKept: Your phone’s position is kept with this photo and the time, to show where it happened. No position? It goes ahead all the same.
driver.loads.remarksHint: Their words go on the consignment note as the receiver’s remarks.
driver.loads.paidSeenHint: Paid by phone? Look on your own phone, not on the shipper’s screen: a payment message can be faked. Not paid yet? You decide whether to hand it over, and you can say later whether it was paid.
driver.mollie.fee: Mollie takes SeeBuyGet’s fee for server costs from it: {fee}.
driver.mollie.show: Show this to the shipper: they scan it with their phone and pay {amount} by iDEAL or card.
driver.mollie.again: The last QR code expired or was not paid: make a new one.
driver.mollie.test: Test payment: no real money moves.
driver.mollie.connect: Connect Mollie in Settings, and the shipper can pay you here from a QR code.
driver.mollie.office: Once the company you drive for connects Mollie, the shipper can pay here from a QR code.
driver.mollie.qrLabel: QR code to pay {amount} by Mollie
driver.loads.addReceiver: Type the name of the person who received the goods.
driver.loads.addPodPhoto: Add a photo of the goods as delivered.
driver.found.toggle: The receiver found something not as the note says
driver.found.title: What the receiver found
driver.found.against: The note says {n, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}}. Count with the receiver, and write only what is not as it says.
driver.found.noCount: The note gives no count of packages. Write what the receiver says is not right.
driver.found.over: Packages more than the note says
driver.found.wrong: Packages that are not the goods on the note
driver.found.refused: Packages the receiver refused (they stay with you)
driver.found.refusedKept: The rest is delivered. The refused packages stay with you: the sender says where they go — back, to another place, or given up — within 48 hours, and you are told.
driver.found.problem.refusedNoCount: The note counts no packages, so a part cannot be refused by count. If the receiver refuses it all, use “I could not deliver” instead.
driver.found.problem.allRefused: {came, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} came and all were refused? Then nothing was handed over: use “I could not deliver” and say it was refused.
driver.found.notIntact: Damaged goods are not intact: “Cargo intact” comes off the unload check, and the damage goes on the note instead.
driver.found.hint: It goes on the consignment note beside the receiver’s name, and the delivery still stands. The sender is told.
driver.found.problem.count: Write a whole number of packages, or leave it empty.
driver.found.problem.photo: Add a photo of what is damaged.
driver.found.problem.noneCame: None of the {n} packages came? Then nothing was handed over: use “I could not deliver” instead.
driver.found.problem.moreThanCame: Only {came, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} came: count only what came.
driver.loads.refusedShort: Refused at the door: keep the goods until the sender says where they go — by {by}.
driver.loads.refusedPartShort: Delivered, with {n, plural, one {# package} other {# packages}} refused: keep {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} until the sender says where {n, plural, one {it goes} other {they go}} — by {by}.
driver.loads.refusedDetail: The sender says where the goods go by {by}: back, to another place, or given up. Keep them with you until then. If the receiver takes them after all, deliver them here as usual.
driver.loads.returnOf: Refused goods of {code}, carried on as this load.
driver.loads.collectAtHub: Collect parcel {parcel} at {hub}’s counter: they hand it to you when you show your pass.
driver.loads.collectFirstTitle: Collect it at the counter first
driver.loads.collectFirstDetail: Show your pass at {hub}’s counter: they scan it and hand you parcel {parcel}. Then take the load over here.
driver.loads.failBody: The goods stay with you. The sender is told what happened and can ring the receiver or tell you where to take them.
driver.loads.failUnreachable: I could not reach the place
driver.loads.handBackBody: Before pickup a load can go back on the market. Say why — the sender and your office are told, and it stays on your record.
